g.text: RoatheRank1Convo1 begins.
Evaluate expressions on HellStory
I really must commend you on your audacity! Truly, are you certain you are not an Orokin in disguise? Perhaps hiding your cerulean skin to keep from alerting the others?!
Update boolean RoatheResetEdgeCase
The Void-born anomaly. "The Drifter." The Usurper. Finally, we speak at last. Come. The Devil has a proposal to make...
false
Hello, Roathe.
What exactly are you accusing me of?
I'm sorry?
Usurper?
What... kind of deal?
What kind of proposal could "the Devil of Tau" possibly have for me?
Hello, Roathe.
Ah, good! You do in fact know my name! I was certain you must have overlooked it somehow, since you were clearly too busy slaughtering me repeatedly!
Do you really have nothing more productive to do?! Or is playing round after round of "Pin the Horn on the Yaznak" really the best use of your time?!
Update boolean RoatheUsurper
Mm, no need for concern... or excitement. Yet. This is merely a business agreement between two individuals who stand to benefit each other greatly.
+5 Chemistry
Now. Listen carefully. The two zealots have been so terribly and painstakingly drab in their repeated objurgation of me. I expect you to rise above such remedial behavior.
I find it very hard to believe that all this - all this injustice I have suffered at your hands, all this peeling away of my psyche has not been purely out of spite at your behest!
+5 Chemistry
I see my reputation precedes me. Good. It will save us some time.
I don't take orders from you.
I'll see what I can do.
It didn't seem like a priority?
I... just I didn't get around to this earlier.
You don't remember... but we've been through this before.
Ah! That is what you are, yes? The Tenno usurped the Origin System from the Orokin. And you, like a little imposter in the nest, have stolen into this world from your own.
And there is no need for concern or excitement... yet. This is merely a business agreement between two individuals who stand to benefit each other greatly.
Evaluate expressions on HellKeyPlayed
See that you do.
It didn't seem like -
Oh! I am so very sorry to have inconvenienced you, I did not realize the slots on your dance card were already booked!
+5 Chemistry
And that makes you, on at least two counts, a Usurper by my measure. (And perhaps a third, if we count what the butler has told me of Duviri, but that is a debate for another time.)
You have made that repeatedly and brutally clear, thank you.
You have made that quite clear.
We shall see.
false
Now, the deal is simple, my charmingly lubricous and vaporous new "friend."
It didn't seem like a priority?!
Really. I am astonished. Your manners are utterly atrocious, Drifter.
Pardon? And how precisely is it that I have come to forget you rummaging through my mind like the Malium Bowl at a Naberus party!
Evaluate expressions on HellKeyPlayed
Do you normally go mouling about in the memories of others, laying waste to their representations, without taking the opportunity to know them first?!
But I suppose there is nothing to be done about it now. You know the truth. I am laid bare to you, in all my abhorrent cowardice.
Long story short, there's... the Infestation that seems to extend to the Protoframe serums...
Ah. Well. So. I have the ability to loop time.
Since you have already been bashing about inside my mind like a drunken razaliorn inside of a glassmaker's shop, I require your assistance in attempting to decode what it all means.
You and the two zealots have already begun messing about inside my mind like a drunk razaliorn inside of a glassmaker's shop. I require your assistance in helping me decode what it all means.
When Albrecht drove the syringe into my neck and turned me into this - thing - he did something else, as well. Games between Orokin are one thing. This? This is something else.
false
Your manners are utterly atrocious!
I assume you have simply come here now to mock me. I request that you have your fill of it now so that we might move on from it uninterrupted.
And I thought that it worked on the Protoframes in 1999 because of the year itself looping, but that's not the case.
Not only do I need your assistance in regaining my memories - but to add insult to injury, I seem unable to even find the means to discern their truth on my own!
He robbed me of much of my memories. I see that little... version of you, running about with all its traumatized Tenno friends. I see what the Lotus is helping it regain.
I would rather not have to continually contend with this being underfoot like some diva's ornamentally bred yapping kubrow.
I think it's... more to do with the Infestation itself? There's a talking guitar that kind of hinted at some of it. And you traveled here in a Helminth, didn't you?
So you're saying you... just need to talk to someone?
I'm happy to help you if I can, I just don't really know how.
So... why don't you go into the dark refractory on your own?
The kid isn't an "it."
You ran. But a lot of people run. It's about facing what happened.
I'm not going to mock you. You made the choice to fight another day.
You seem alarmingly uncertain about this entire conversation, Drifter. Especially when it comes to the contents of my skull.
Oh do not make this sound like I simply need to lay on some reclined sofa and speak through my "feelings."
I need someone to operate the machine at my behest, as I am currently incapable of doing so myself.
I would do the deed myself, believe me - but I cannot! The blasted protoframe serum Albrecht poisoned me with removed any ability I have of operating the damnable contraption on my own!
I assure you, "it" very much is.
Add 1 to Thermostat
Add -1 to Thermostat
And yes. I did come here via a Helminth. That I engineered and grew myself, thank you. Now. You mean to tell me that you have... erased my memories?! Of what, our conversations together?!
I am also in need of someone to help me record my memories and assist me in reconciling them. A temporary assistant of sorts.
And in addition, not only do I need your assistance in regaining my memories - but to add insult to injury, I seem unable to even find the means to discern their truth on my own!
And I would do the deed myself, believe me - but I cannot! The blasted protoframe serum Albrecht poisoned me with removed any ability I have of operating the damnable contraption on my own!
Fantastic. Another buzzing dolefly to dart around my ears and tell me I am in need of self-reflection and reptentance?
+5 Chemistry
Because I certainly have perfectly "fond" memories of you rendering me unto mincemeat for your own sanguinary entertainment. How is that meant to make any sense whatsoever?

And in return - you will have my solemn pledge that I will sit here... peacefully. I will pose no one any threat, of which I assure you... I am quite capable of being. I will do no harm to the zealots. Or to the butler. Or to Albrecht's Void-corrupted animals.
Lucky me.
Currently, what I am doing seems to be "moldering in a crypt with a pair of gormless zealots and dolling out trinkets to war-traumatized children."
I don't know, and I'm not exactly here to continue taking abuse from you, Roathe. I didn't loop everyone just so I could catch flack from you over it.
As far as I can guess? Our conversations aren't deep rooted. They're surface memories. What we uncovered in your past were... more part of your core memories, I guess?
And more importantly, I will do no harm to Albrecht's twisted family that sits about like so much mutated flora above us - unwitting to our very presence.
I plan to go about my business, Drifter, but the fact remains - you know too much about my past and what I've done. And we will have to simply... exist in this state.
But I suppose that must be what they call it now.
Yes. I could hazard a guess as to why you have summoned your Void-gifts to wipe our minds of recent events. How perfectly predictable.
Fantastic. Utterly marvelous. I am in the hands now of a lunatic who has the ability to wipe my memories clean at a whim! How adorable.
I thought this was a deal. Now you're threatening me?
Roathe? Please stop and listen to me for a second.
What do you need me to do?
Try not to make this too unduly uncomfortable for me and I will promise that I shall try to do the same in return.
Well. If what you say is true - and I suppose this tale is mad enough to be reality - I will attempt not to hold it against you that you know this deep and terrible truth of mine.
Were you not paying attention? Really, reading comprehension these days... I was not threatening you, Usurper. Nor was I threatening anyone else.
This ought to be grand. Please. Go right ahead; the proverbial theatre is yours.
Were you not paying attention? Really, reading comprehension these days... I am attempting to strike a deal with you, Usurper. I have a hard time believing you cannot follow along.
No.
I think that's fair.
Though I would request - if I may - that you would get your fill of whatever mocking you wish to levy in my direction so that we might move on from it uninterrupted.
I was merely stating that should we reach a point where I am unable to reach my end goals, I may have no reason to sit quietly any longer.
I'm the reason Ballas is dead. Don't make me clear my schedule.
If you want my help, this isn't a very good way of getting it.
I know you and I don't have much experience with each other - not really. But I'm here to help you.
If my proposal does not reach your standards, shall I sweeten it for you?
+5 Chemistry
+15 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
And if you want mine, then I suggest - as I said - we come to an agreement.
And? Ah. I see. You are objecting to my "tone" is it? I am so terribly sorry. I did not realize you bristle so easily.
It has come to my attention that there are a great many matters around Deimos where my assistance could be considered not only viable, but I dare say, crucial.
Ha! I do have to respect your honesty, if nothing else.
Wonderful. It is good to know you are at least... agreeable.
If you could have just heard me laugh! Thank you, Drifter, for very much not being tedious!
Including, but not limited to, the reconciliation of one lovelorn butler and said estranged family who lives upstairs.
Update boolean RoatheKnowsReset
Add -1 to Thermostat
A family who, as I mentioned, has no idea that we are even down here. And has no knowledge of Albrecht's continued existence amongst the living, am I correct?
At least this will be interesting.
What a delight that was! I think you and I will be friends, indeed. This was quite wonderful.
You're offering to help convince Loid to... talk to the Entrati family?
I can't convince Loid to do anything about it. He claims it'd be too painful for them.
They don't know Albrecht Entrati is still alive, no.
Chat ends.
I think, for that, I shall reward you. And make my end of the deal just a little bit sweeter for you. Such audacity is rare.
Not for free, my Void-addled Usurper.
You cannot. But I promise you... I can.
And where you have failed to convince that disconsolate manservant? I promise you... I can.
And so we finally come to my proposal: help me sort out the matter of my missing memories, and get to the "bottom" of it all - no pun intended.
And I will ensure our heartsick servant walks up those stairs. And, in the meanwhile, I will seat peacefully... and be no danger to anyone. What say you? Do we have a deal?
No deal.
Deal.
As you wish. But fair warning:
+5 Chemistry
Update boolean RoatheNoDeal
Good! Glad to see you aren't a fool. As they say:
Crossing a devil is worse than dealing with one.
Update boolean RoatheDeal
Both you'll come to regret, but only with one do you stand to benefit.
Chat ends.
